PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: rate limit (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.2) should a mix of dry and real submissions share ONE rate-limit budget
PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: rate limit (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.2) should a hook-triggered (External) submission is rejected exactly like a manual one
PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: rate limit (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.2) should a scheduled submission is rejected exactly like a manual one
PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: concurrency cap (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.1) should rejects more than maxConcurrent REAL concurrent submissions with TooManyRequests
PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: concurrency cap (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.1) should completing a run frees a slot for a subsequent submission (AC's own integration-test requirement)
PipelineRunService pipeline-run guard: concurrency cap (HEL-505 tasks.md 8.1) should dry runs are NOT subject to the concurrency cap even when the owner is already at the real-run cap (C7)
